blocks.title: 📰 2. 🏛️ REGULATORY BODIES NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 SEBI Amends FPI Regulations: Rupee-Denominated Fee Structure & Pre-IPO ESOPs. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Replaces USD registration fees with INR structure (Category-I FPI (foreign portfolio investors holding liquid assets) fee ₹2.3 lakh).
Rupee Fee Structure: Category-I FPI (foreign portfolio investors holding liquid assets) registration fee fixed at ₹2.3 lakh (replaced ,500); ,000 fee replaced by ₹90,000.
Custodian Monthly Fee: Custodian fee revised to ₹85,000/month (replaced ₹10 lakh annual fee).
Intraday MF Borrowing: Mutual funds permitted intraday borrowing up to 20% of net assets for settlement liquidity.
Category-I FPI (foreign portfolio investors holding liquid assets) registration fee (₹2.3 lakh) vs custodian monthly fee (₹85,000).
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on statutory circular guidelines, compliance deadlines, penal provisions, and applicability thresholds across scheduled banks.
